info.title: API.SH: Fandom
info.description: The Fandom API from API.SH: public Fandom data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The pages, subcategories and files in a category of a Fandom wiki, with the category's counts. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fandom-category

parameters.name: wiki
parameters.description: The wiki's name as in its address, or the wiki URL.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Member types joined with | (default page|subcat): page, subcat, file.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order by sort key (default) or by when the page was added.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language edition of the wiki. Default English.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A wiki's Discussions threads: id, title, forum, type (text, poll, image), author, date, replies, upvotes, trending score, locked flag, text, linked articles, poll question and answers with votes, images and link, with the wiki's thread and post totals. Pass `next_page` back as `page` (and `next_pivot` as `pivot` to keep the list stable); null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fandom-discussions

parameters.description: The wiki's name as in its address (starwars for starwars.fandom.com) or its link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One page of a Fandom wiki: title, ids, a summary, the infobox as fields (with its image), the text by section as plain text, categories, linked pages, external links, images, other-language versions, the page's license and URL. Also the latest revision (id, time, editor, size), page length, gallery images with captions, data tables as rows of cells, the numbered references, and each infobox's type and image caption. `section` returns one section, `revision_id` an older revision, and `format=html` or `format=wikitext` adds the page source in that form. On wikis whose license is NonCommercial the section text is left out (headings, infobox facts, categories and links are returned).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fandom-page

parameters.name: wiki
parameters.description: The wiki's name as in its address, or the wiki URL.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Page title (spaces or underscores). The wiki's main page when neither title nor page_id is given.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language edition of the wiki (e.g. de, es, fr). Default English.

parameters.name: section
parameters.description: One section only, by number: 0 is the lead, 1 the first heading, and so on.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: text (default) or also the source: html adds `html`, wikitext adds `wikitext`.

parameters.name: revision_id
parameters.description: An older revision of the page by revision id (alias oldid).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every registered user who edited a wiki page, by name: user id, user name and profile link, plus the number of anonymous contributors. Filter by user group (`group=sysop`) or leave a group out (`exclude_group=bot`). Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fandom-page-contributors

parameters.name: wiki
parameters.description: The wiki's name as in its address (starwars for starwars.fandom.com) or its link.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language edition (e.g. de) when not English.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Only contributors in this user group (e.g. sysop, bot, content-moderator, rollback).

parameters.name: exclude_group
parameters.description: Leave out contributors in this user group (e.g. bot).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The pages a wiki page links to (`direction=out`) or the pages linking to it (`direction=in`, with redirect flags), with titles, ids, namespaces and links. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fandom-page-links

parameters.name: wiki
parameters.description: The wiki's name as in its address (starwars for starwars.fandom.com) or its link.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language edition (e.g. de) when not English.

parameters.name: redirects
parameters.description: With direction=in: false leaves redirects out.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A wiki page's revisions: revision and parent id, time, editor (or anonymous), minor flag, edit summary, size and size change, tags and links to the revision and its diff. Newest first by default. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fandom-page-revisions

parameters.name: wiki
parameters.description: The wiki's name as in its address (starwars for starwars.fandom.com) or its link.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language edition (e.g. de) when not English.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A wiki's page rankings from its own statistics: most linked, most edited, most categorised, most used files, most used categories and templates, longest, most wanted (missing) and newest pages, with rank, title, the ranking value and link. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fandom-popular

parameters.name: wiki
parameters.description: The wiki's name as in its address (starwars for starwars.fandom.com) or its link.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language edition (e.g. de) when not English.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Recent edits and new pages on a Fandom wiki: page, change type, revision, time, size before and after, minor and new-page flags. Editors are not returned. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fandom-recent

parameters.name: wiki
parameters.description: The wiki's name as in its address, or the wiki URL.

parameters.name: type

get.description:
Full-text or title search on any Fandom wiki: page title, id, word count, size, last edit time, redirect and section matched, and the page URL. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fandom-search

parameters.name: wiki
parameters.description: The wiki's name as in its address (harrypotter for harrypotter.fandom.com), or the wiki URL.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language edition of the wiki (e.g. de for starwars.fandom.com/de). Default English.

parameters.name: what
parameters.description: text (default) searches page text; prefix lists pages whose title starts with q.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A wiki contributor: user id, edit count on the wiki, registration date, user groups (admin, moderator...), block state, profile link and their recent edits (page, time, summary, size change, new page flag). Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` for older edits; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fandom-user

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
